My dear [Miss Smith](/person/263)
Articles addressed to the Ed of [M P](/periodical/52) go to [Miss Coleridge](/person/329).[^1] She has been from home and things go to arrears, which she has hardly made up yet, but I will tell her to see about your paper.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Joint editorship of the MP began in July 1891. CMY retired from the editorship in December 1893.
